summary: A 1929 frame cabin on the high point of West Cady Ridge, removed or destroyed in 1965. Part of a footing and a foundation remain near the summit.

facts.design: 11-by-11-foot frame cabin with a 6-by-6-foot second-floor cupola
facts.status_note: Cabin removed or destroyed in 1965; part of one footing and a foundation remain.

access.note: Reached on foot by the West Cady Ridge trail, which runs through wilderness. No closure appears in the pages read.

visit.trail_note: WillhiteWeb lists an 8-mile hiking distance; SummitPost puts the round trip closer to 14 miles.

events.note: Cabin built; WillhiteWeb says work ran over the summers of 1929 and 1930
FFLOS says removed; firelookout.com and WillhiteWeb say destroyed

resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS says the cabin was removed in 1965; firelookout.com and WillhiteWeb say it was destroyed that year. The story reports both words and does not choose one.
FFLOS and firelookout.com give 1929 as the build year. WillhiteWeb says the cabin was built over the summers of 1929 and 1930.

notes_for_editor: Build year (1929) and removal year (1965) agree across sources, but the wording differs (removed or destroyed). The 2021 remains rest on one WillhiteWeb trip page. Access and trip length come from a SummitPost guide, so check the current wilderness rules. The brief's kind 'ground' may be wrong: WillhiteWeb says the 1934 panoramas were taken 25 feet above ground, which suggests the cabin stood on posts or a tower. Check before changing kind.
